pattern: Adds the numerators and the denominators separately, so 1/2 + 1/3 becomes 2/5.
correction: The denominator names the size of the pieces. Rewrite over a common denominator first: 1/2 + 1/3 = 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6.

pattern: Finds a common denominator but forgets to change the numerators to match.
correction: Whatever the denominator is multiplied by, the numerator is multiplied by the same number, so the fraction keeps its value.
